target: At least 2 of 4 fixed domains crossed at recorded follow-up relative to first scan
predictor_reference: first scan only; no observed slope predictors
selection_rule: Complete parsed adults age 18-100; interval 90 days to 5 years; no CXL-label-based relabelling.
label: Model-estimated numerical threshold crossing at a 12-month scan

bootstrap.note: Patient-cluster bootstrap of fixed averaged OOF predictions; does not refit or capture all model-development uncertainty.

validation.reuse_caveat: All fitted NKPI ridge weights, forecast scalers, model-family and penalty selection refitted without held-out patients. The positive affine frozen NKPI calibration cancels for standardized logits. This cohort was used in earlier development; no independent external or prospective validation.

near_twelve_months.note: Primary nested evaluation on observed 9–15 month scans, not exact 12-month events or independent external validation.

domain_rules.label: Anterior curvature
domain_rules.rule: ARC decrease >0.106 mm OR Kmax increase >1 D

limitations: Selected CXL/control cohort; sample response is not population-calibrated patient risk.
Numerical outcome is not independently adjudicated clinical progression.
Variable follow-up and incomplete treatment/quality audit; no exact first-crossing time.
Forecast assumes comparable untreated scans; no CXL treatment benefit is estimated.
Internal validation only; no external fixed-horizon validation.
NKPI is derived from the same baseline variables; it adds no new measured information.

All fitted NKPI ridge weights, forecast scalers, model-family and penalty selection refitted without held-out patients. The positive affine frozen NKPI calibration cancels for standardized logits. This cohort was used in earlier development; no independent external or prospective validation.
Only one eligible development eye has baseline NKPI >=65; high-score extrapolation is poorly supported.
No manual probability floors or clinic-detection-rate substitution.

trajectory.target: Six signed tomography changes; constrained central untreated scenario; frozen baseline NKPI rescored with age held constant
assumptions: Nonnegative structural worsening drift is imposed on the central scenario; it is not a finding that all untreated eyes worsen.
Nonnegative NKPI/activity association is an explicit clinic-informed research constraint, not a validated threshold at 20, 50 or 65.
Younger age and steeper Kmax cannot reduce activity at fixed other predictor summaries; thinner cornea is a candidate severity interaction, not an established causal rule.
One shared activity factor couples all six rates; no individual measurement trajectory is known from one scan.
Current age is held constant for future NKPI calculations. No room-to-100 term enters the biological forecast.
Actual negative changes remain in fitting and validation. No fabricated clinic cases or externally borrowed outcome labels.
Paired source is intended pretreatment but timing and quality require audit; no CXL treatment effect is estimated.

evidence.use: Age and baseline steepness directions only; hazard ratios are not applied as individual rates.
External aggregate context for age/Kmax directions; pooled mean and meta-regression not transplanted to this cohort.
Progressive untreated eyes may worsen and CXL changes trajectory; no treatment-effect simulation from this study.

clinic_evidence.use: Direction constraint only. User reports high NKPI in clinically progressing eyes scheduled for CXL.

trajectory.reuse_caveat: Conditional repeated nested patient-grouped assessment. The frozen NKPI input/target was developed on overlapping records. Not fully independent end-to-end, external or prospective validation.

score_band_audit.basis: Frozen baseline NKPI on development records; descriptive frequencies, not held-out calibration or patient probabilities.

clinic_validation.provenance: User-reported clinic result; case-level outcomes and denominator not available to this fit.

calibration_diagnostic.note: Descriptive held-out diagnostic, not a correction applied to the displayed forecast; small sample.

legacy_v83.note: Historical v8.3 conditional assessment with reused fixed NKPI; not directly comparable with the refitted nested procedure.
